source.name: Football Shirt Culture: South Africa 2026 Adidas Home Kit
source.note: Kit maker. Named-press kit write-up: the shirt carries the updated SAFA crest, the South African Football Association emblem and the adidas logo on the chest, with green shorts with yellow adidas stripes and yellow socks; no commercial sponsor on any placement. Footy Headlines' launch write-up (2026-03-03) describes the same layout, and the launch gallery photos show no commercial marks on the front or sleeves.
source.quote: On the chest, the updated SAFA crest is applied alongside the adidas logo, with the authentic version incorporating a lenticular heat applied finish.

summary: adidas home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle (adidas replaced Le Coq Sportif as SAFA's technical sponsor). No commercial shirt sponsors: Football Shirt Culture's launch write-up describes only the SAFA crest, SAFA emblem and adidas branding on the shirt, with matching sponsor-free green shorts and yellow socks.
